name: Polygon-based Volumetric Rendering with Depth Peeling
definition: A technique to render solid 3D bodies from volumetric data by constructing a mesh of polygons (slices) and applying a 3D texture, using an undocumented rendering option to handle transparency sorting.
summary: Polygon-based Volumetric Rendering with Depth Peeling renders 3D volumes using textured polygon meshes and depth peeling for correct translucent ordering, unlike standard texture slicing.
